parsed.rationale: All four participating records are anonymous extensions (name is empty string, fields_or_signature is empty) spread across test files in the Playback and MusicShareKit packages. The cluster carries no structural evidence — jaccard, shared_field_count, shared_ancestor, and differing_slots are all null — meaning the pipeline surfaced these solely on a name-collision signal for 'Tag', yet none of the records actually declare a type named 'Tag'. With no shared members, no shared ancestor, and no meaningful overlap to consolidate, the coincidence is purely structural noise from the query rather than a real duplication opportunity.
